name: cobol-root-endpoint-id-shape-guard
body: root_edge_endpoint roots a cobol endpoint with no non-empty module prefix to the root module cobol., but skips endpoints shaped cb followed by digits so opaque ids are never rerooted. Limit: the guard hard-codes the cobol id prefix cb, and a COBOL name spelled cb plus digits would not be rooted. Upgrade by passing the stream's emitted id set into the rooter.
